Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 05 (Five) years.
2. A satisfactory completion of similar works of at least Tk 150 (ONE Hundred Fifty) lac under single contract over a period of 5
(Five) years shall be required in any government, semi-government or autonomous body.
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk 3(Three) crore over the last best three (3) years in
the last five (5) years.
4. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk 100 (One hundred) Lac.
5. The tenderer should have updated trade license, TIN and VAT certificate and incorporation certificate.
6. The tenderer should have minimum one work done certificate with E-gp ID should be submitted in last 5 years.
5. The bidder must have Electrical A-B-C licences from electrification Board.
7. others qualification criteria as stated in TDS.
